limitations: Computational QA limits are prespecified exploratory guards, not an anatomical or formal AR certificate.
One Ernie head; template-derived DK40 source domain and template scalp coordinates matched to BioSemi64 labels.
Geometry uses approximate anatomical coordinate masks and clipped graph-radius patches, not validated hairless skin masks.
Twenty-eight geometry configurations are not an exhaustive center/area/electrode optimization.
Grid localization remains affected by shared-model inverse crime and has no continuous surface refinement.
No confidence bound across independent heads and no formal AR pass/fail are calculated.
Field values are explained-energy fractions and reference-relative retention, not classification or localization accuracy.
All candidate and reference layouts have 64 measurement electrodes; only precomputed SNR conditions are exported, without interpolation or formal AR decisions.
Region areas are approximate barycentric areas of candidate patches; they are not electrode convex-hull areas or validated hairless skin boundaries.
Localization is available only for the reference and four geometry-prefrozen layouts. Null means not evaluated, never zero error or a failed result.
Noiseless grid matching already exhibits substantial baseline error; a nearby dictionary coordinate does not guarantee matching cortical normal or scalp field.
Official nearest-GM interpolation is an exploratory source-model approximation for points not inside segmented GM; source-domain anatomy is not certified.
